Adding 27 tablets (batch B013-HC002, expires in 668 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹817 vehicle, and averts an expected 27.0 tablets of unmet demand, though the shelf stays short enough that the stock-out risk remains 100%.
